create_dataset_bitext: create a Dataset dataclass with src and tgt paths for a bilingual bitext corpus
create_dataset_monolingual: create a Dataset dataclass with only a src path for a monolingual corpus
create_dataset_mined_tsv: create a Dataset dataclass with a tsv path for a mined TSV corpus
read_dataset_lines: use DatasetReader as a context manager to iterate over DatasetLine objects from a corpus
read_dataset_with_offset: use DatasetReader with line_offset_start and line_offset_end to read a subset of lines
